Messages.Author: Jeff Dai
Messages.Body:
This just occured to me and I was hoping someone had an answer.

Does a Catiff change sects when Revelations of the Sire is played? If so
who do you look for which sect the Catiff changes to (the new clan or the
vampire revealing?)

ie. if Jost Werner RotS Igo does Igo become a Camarilla !Toreador or a
Sabbat !Toreador.

How about if a more complicated clan such as the Daughters of
Cacophony does the revealing. Overall the clan is independant but Muse is
Sabbat and Angela Preston is Camarilla......

Jeff

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jeff Dai wrote:
>
> This just occured to me and I was hoping someone had an answer.
>
> Does a Catiff change sects when Revelations of the Sire is played? If so
> who do you look for which sect the Catiff changes to (the new clan or the
> vampire revealing?)

Yes. New Clan. See explicit rule in section 10.

> ie. if Jost Werner RotS Igo does Igo become a Camarilla !Toreador or a
> Sabbat !Toreador.

The latter.

> How about if a more complicated clan such as the Daughters of
> Cacophony does the revealing. Overall the clan is independant but Muse is
> Sabbat and Angela Preston is Camarilla......

Overall.
